item.title: Yoo Jeong-bok in Red Jacket Formally Declares Candidacy for Third Term as Incheon Mayor: "Completing a World-Class City" (빨간 점퍼 입은 유정복, 3선 인천시장 출마 공식 선언 “세계 초일류 도시 완성”)
item.description:
Yoo Jeong-bok in Red Jacket Formally Declares Candidacy for Third Term as Incheon Mayor: "Completing a World-Class City" (빨간 점퍼 입은 유정복, 3선 인천시장 출마 공식 선언 “세계 초일류 도시 완성”)

People Power Party's Incheon Mayor candidate Yoo Jeong-bok officially declared his candidacy for the June 3 Incheon mayoral election on the 29th. Mayor Yoo made his declaration wearing the party's signature red jacket. (국민의힘 유정복 인천시장 후보가 29일 6·3 인천시장 선거 출마를 공식 선언했다. 유 시장은 당의 색깔인 빨간색 점퍼를 입고 출마 선언을 했다.)

After registering as a preliminary candidate for Incheon mayor on the morning of this day, Candidate Yoo made his declaration at the plaza in front of Incheon City Hall, stating, "Based on the achievements of the past four years, where Incheon recorded the highest economic growth rate and the fastest population growth rate in South Korea, I have decided to run to complete a 'world-class city where citizens are happy.'" Candidate Yoo served three terms as a National Assembly member, held the positions of Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries and Minister of Public Administration and Security, and served as Incheon mayor from 2014 to 2018 and 2022 to 2026. If Candidate Yoo wins, he will become the first three-term mayor in Incheon's history. (유 후보는 이날 오전 인천시장 예비후보로 등록한 뒤 인천시청 앞 광장에서 출마 선언을 하면서 “지난 4년간 인천이 대한민국에서 가장 높은 경제성장률과 가장 빠른 인구 증가율을 기록한 성과를 토대로 ‘시민이 행복한 세계 초일류 도시’를 완성하기 위해 출마를 결심했다”고 밝혔다. 유 후보는 3선 국회의원을 지냈고, 농림수산식품부 장관과 행정안전부 장관을 거쳐 2014∼2018년, 2022∼2026년 인천시장을 지냈다. 유 후보가 승리할 경우 역대 인천시장 최초로 3선 시장이 된다.)

Candidate Yoo stated, "Yoo Jeong-bok, with 'unrivaled competitiveness' that has been verified by citizens, acknowledged by South Korea, and evaluated globally, will once again give his all to work for the people," adding, "Incheon is leading the growth and development of South Korea with new policies such as the 1,000-won housing for newlyweds and 100 million won support for newborns." He continued, "I will protect Incheon more strongly for the next four years." (유 후보는 “시민이 검증했고, 대한민국이 인정했고, 세계에서도 평가한 ‘비교불가 경쟁력’ 유정복이 다시 한번 온몸을 불살라 시민을 위해 일할 것”이라며 “인천은 신혼부부 천원주택, 신생아 1억원 지원 등 새로운 정책들로 대한민국의 성장과 발전을 주도하고 있다”고 말했다. 이어 “앞으로 4년 인천을 더 강하게 지켜내겠다”고 했다.)

Targeting Democratic Party of Korea Incheon mayoral candidate Assemblyman Park Chan-dae, Candidate Yoo said, "This election is about choosing whether to select a spokesperson for Incheon citizens or a proxy from the central government," and added, "I, who have protected Incheon, will grow Incheon into a global city." (유 후보는 더불어민주당 인천시장 후보인 박찬대 의원을 겨냥해 “이번 선거는 인천시민의 대변인을 선택할 것인가, 중앙의 대리인을 선택할 것인가를 정하는 것”이라며 “인천을 지켜온 제가 인천을 세계로 키우겠다”고 말했다.)

If successful in winning a third consecutive term, Candidate Yoo promised to pursue an "Incheon International Free Special City," saying, "Through a special law, I will free Incheon from metropolitan area regulations and develop the area around Incheon Airport into a global airport economic zone that leads South Korea's future growth." He added, "Currently, the entire country is suffering from administrative integration. Since metropolitan cities are destined to disappear under these circumstances, it is the right time to push for an international free special city that enhances Incheon's unique international competitiveness." (유 후보는 3선 연임 성공 시 ‘인천국제자유특별시’ 추진을 약속하면서 “특별법을 통해 인천을 수도권 규제에서 벗어나게 하고 인천공항 주변을 대한민국 미래 성장을 이끄는 글로벌 공항경제권으로 키우겠다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “지금 전국이 행정통합으로 몸살을 앓고 있다”며 “광역시는 이대로라면 어차피 없어질 명칭이 된 만큼 인천만의 국제 경쟁력을 키워내는 국제자유특별시를 추진할 적기”라고 했다.)

Furthermore, Candidate Yoo presented overcoming discrimination against the capital region, expanding '1,000-won policies' for citizen happiness, strengthening support for low birth rates and childcare, and balanced development of the old city center as major pending issues and future projects for Incheon. Candidate Yoo also stated his intention to develop the Songdo K-Bio Lab Hub into a future industrial hub where bio, semiconductor, and advanced research grow together. (또 유 후보는 인천의 주요 현안과 향후 추진 사업으로 수도권 역차별 극복, 시민 행복을 위한 ‘천원 정책’ 확대, 저출생·보육 지원 강화, 원도심 균형 발전 등을 제시했다. 유 후보는 송도 K-바이오 랩허브를 중심으로 바이오, 반도체, 첨단연구가 함께 성장하는 미래 산업 거점으로 키우겠다고도 했다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh: "Reducing Redevelopment Period to Within 10 Years"... Oh Se-hoon: "Bridging Health Disparities" (정원오 “정비사업 기간 10년 이내로”…오세훈 “건강 격차 해소”)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh: "Reducing Redevelopment Period to Within 10 Years"... Oh Se-hoon: "Bridging Health Disparities" (정원오 “정비사업 기간 10년 이내로”…오세훈 “건강 격차 해소”)

Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul Mayor, visited the Jangwi Redevelopment District in Seongbuk-gu, Seoul on the 29th and announced a "Steady Development" real estate pledge centered on shortening the redevelopment period and large-scale supply of "practical housing." (정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 29일 서울 성북구 장위재개발지구를 찾아 정비사업 기간 단축과 ‘실속 주택’ 대규모 공급 등을 골자로 하는 ‘착착개발’ 부동산 공약을 발표했다.)

Candidate Jung stated that through deregulation, legislative amendments, and improved project feasibility, the current redevelopment period of around 15 years would be drastically shortened to within 10 years. He pledged to provide close support for the entire process, from the start of redevelopment to occupancy, to accelerate development speed. (정 후보는 규제 완화·법 개정·사업성 개선 등을 통해 현재 15년 안팎인 정비사업 기간을 10년 이내로 대폭 단축하겠다고 밝혔다. 정비사업 시작부터 입주까지 전 과정을 밀착 지원해 개발 속도를 높이겠다는 것이다.)

Candidate Jung also said he would significantly improve the feasibility of redevelopment and reconstruction projects. The plan includes expanding areas eligible for floor area ratio favors to semi-industrial zones and raising the calculation standards for rental housing prices to reduce losses for unions. Additionally, the scope of free transfer of national and public land to project operators will be expanded to compensate for losses from donations. (정 후보는 재개발·재건축의 사업성도 대폭 개선하겠다고 밝혔다. 용적률 특혜 지역을 준공업지역으로 확대하고, 임대주택 가격 산정 기준을 상향해 조합의 손실을 줄인다는 계획이다. 또 기부채납으로 인한 손실 보전을 위해 사업자에 대한 국공유지 무상 귀속 범위를 확대할 방침이다.)

Candidate Jung vowed to revitalize public redevelopment projects and supply a large number of practical housing units. He stated, "We will provide a large-scale supply of public housing with sale prices and rents affordable for middle-class homeless citizens." (정 후보는 공공정비사업을 활성화하고 실속 주택도 대규모로 공급하겠다고 했다. 정 후보는 “무주택 중산층 서민들도 부담 가능한 분양가와 임대료의 공공주택을 대규모로 공급하겠다”고 했다.)

On the same day, Candidate Oh announced his first pledge, "Iron Health, Vibrant Seoul," at the Dobong-gu Public Health Center in Seoul. The aim is to create an urban environment where anyone can enjoy a healthy daily life regardless of their residential area or income level. (오 후보는 이날 서울 도봉구보건소에서 1호 공약으로 ‘강철 체력, 활력 서울’을 발표했다. 거주 지역이나 소득 수준과 관계없이 누구나 건강한 일상을 누리는 도시 환경을 조성하겠다는 것이다.)

Candidate Oh said, "No matter where you live or what you do, health should not be a goal but an everyday part of life in Seoul," adding, "Reducing health disparities by region and income is a key task to complete the 'Special City of Quality of Life' and enhance urban competitiveness." (오 후보는 “어디에 살든, 어떤 일을 하든 건강은 목표가 아니라 서울에서의 일상 그 자체여야 한다”며 “지역·소득별 건강 격차를 줄이는 것이야말로 ‘삶의 질 특별시’를 완성하고 도시 경쟁력을 높이는 핵심 과제”라고 했다.)

Candidate Oh pledged to upgrade the health management platform "Wrist Doctor 9988," which he created during his tenure as Seoul Mayor, into an AI-based super app. It will feature the ability to predict risks of chronic and serious diseases by reflecting individual health checkup results. (오 후보는 서울시장으로 재임하며 만든 건강관리 플랫폼 ‘손목닥터 9988’을 AI 기반 수퍼 앱으로 고도화하겠다고 했다. 개인별 건강검진 결과를 반영해 만성질환 및 중대질환 위험도를 예측하는 기능을 갖추겠다는 것이다.)

Regarding the choice of the Gangbuk region for the first pledge announcement, Candidate Oh said, "We must be most vigilant about income disparities leading to health disparities." (오 후보는 첫 공약 발표 장소를 강북권으로 정한 것과 관련해 “소득 격차가 건강 격차로 이어지는 것을 가장 경계해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Amid Criticism That High Oil Price Subsidies Cannot Be Used at Gas Stations... President Lee Orders "Review Relaxing Restrictions" (‘주유소서 못 쓰는 고유가 지원금’ 지적에... 李대통령 “풀어주는 것 검토하라”)
item.description:
Amid Criticism That High Oil Price Subsidies Cannot Be Used at Gas Stations... President Lee Orders "Review Relaxing Restrictions" (‘주유소서 못 쓰는 고유가 지원금’ 지적에... 李대통령 “풀어주는 것 검토하라”)

Regarding the issue that the government's "high oil price damage subsidy" is partially restricted from use at gas stations, President Lee Jae-myung has instructed officials to consider lifting the restrictions on gas station usage. <<> Cheong Wa Dae Senior Communications Secretary Lee Kyu-yeon said on KBS radio on the 29th, "President Lee instructed yesterday to review lifting the restrictions on gas station use." <<> The high oil price damage subsidy, which began disbursement on the 27th, is restricted from use at gas stations with annual sales exceeding 3 billion won. This has led to criticism that despite the subsidy being named "high oil price damage subsidy," it cannot be used at gas stations, causing confusion. <<> On this issue, Senior Secretary Lee stated, "(The high oil price damage subsidy) was created for small business owners and those in need, so in that sense, it is right not to use it at gas stations with sales over 3 billion won," but added, "However, since the public intuitively perceives it as a subsidy for high oil prices, the President thought it should at least allow people to buy fuel, so he instructed a review toward lifting the restriction." <<> Senior Secretary Lee said that during a meeting with senior aides, President Lee "asked for a show of hands to hear opinions, and each gave their views. He listens to his aides' opinions and questions, then makes decisions." <<> In relation to this, a Cheong Wa Dae official commented, "Since there is potential for misunderstanding, the idea is to temporarily relax the rule to allow use regardless of sales scale, and review a plan for that," adding, "Nothing has been firmly decided; it's just recognizing public inconvenience and beginning a review." (정부가 지급하는 ‘고유가 피해 지원금’이 주유소에서는 사용이 일부 제한되는 문제와 관련해, 이재명 대통령이 주유소 사용 제한을 해제하는 방안을 검토해보라고 지시했다.)

item.title: First Lady Kim Keon-hee Attends "Hope Cookie" Making Event with Children with Glycogen Storage Disease (김혜경 여사, 당원병 환아 찾아 ‘희망쿠키’ 만들기 행사 참석)
item.description:
First Lady Kim Keon-hee Attends "Hope Cookie" Making Event with Children with Glycogen Storage Disease (김혜경 여사, 당원병 환아 찾아 ‘희망쿠키’ 만들기 행사 참석)

First Lady Kim Keon-hee made cookies alongside children suffering from the rare disease glycogen storage disease on the 29th, offering them encouragement and support. (김혜경 여사가 29일 희소 질환인 당원병 환아들과 함께 쿠키를 만들며 이들에게 격려와 응원을 보냈다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong conveyed in a written briefing that Kim visited the Children’s Grand Park in Gwangjin-gu, Seoul, on this day to participate in a "Hope Cookie" making activity with children battling glycogen storage disease. Glycogen storage disease is a rare condition where the body cannot properly break down glycogen, leading to repeated episodes of hypoglycemia. The Hope Cookie is a snack developed by parents of children with this disease, with a reduced carbohydrate content. This event was arranged as a follow-up to the "Communication Event with Rare Disease Patients and Their Families" held on December 24 last year, which President Yoon Suk Yeol and First Lady Kim attended. (김 여사는 이날 서울 광진구 어린이대공원을 찾아 당원병을 앓고 있는 어린이들과 함께 ‘희망쿠키’ 만들기 체험 활동에 함께 참여했다고 안귀령 부대변인이 서면 브리핑에서 전했다. 당원병은 당을 제대로 분해하지 못해 저혈당이 반복되는 희소 질환으로, 희망쿠키는 당원병 환아를 위해 부모들이 탄수화물 비중을 낮춰 직접 개발한 간식이다. 이번 일정은 지난해 12월 24일 이 대통령 부부가 참석했던 ‘희소 질환 환우 및 가족들과의 소통행사’의 후속 행사 차원으로 마련됐다.)

At the event, Kim said, "The story of the Hope Cookie I heard last Christmas Eve has stayed with me," adding, "I really wanted to be part of making cookies that children with glycogen storage disease can eat without worry." Wearing an apron, she made the Hope Cookies with the children, encouraging them by saying, "You're doing so well. Did you practice before coming?" (김 여사는 이날 행사에서 “지난 크리스마스이브에 들은 희망쿠키 이야기가 계속 마음에 남아있었다”며 “당원병 아이들이 걱정 없이 마음껏 먹을 수 있는 쿠키를 만드는 자리에 꼭 함께하고 싶었다”고 했다. 김 여사는 앞치마를 하고 환아들과 희망 쿠키를 만들면서 함께한 어린이들에게 “너무 잘한다. 연습하고 온 것 아니냐”며 격려를 보냈다.)

She also remarked, "The Hope Cookie seems like it would be a great healthy snack to make at home. It would also go well as a late-night snack for the President," adding, "My husband eats something at night, so I think it would be nice to make these for him." Introducing Joon-woo Jang, a student who entered Minjok Leadership Academy despite having glycogen storage disease, she cheered, "I hope you all grow up to be as impressive and healthy as Joon-woo oppa." (또 “희망 쿠키는 일반 가정에서 건강한 간식으로 만들어 먹기 좋을 것 같다. 이 대통령의 야식으로도 잘 어울리겠다”며 “남편도 밤에 뭐를 드시는데, 이런 것을 만들어 드리면 좋을 것 같다”고 언급하기도 했다. 당원병을 앓으면서도 민족사관고등학교에 진학한 장준우 학생을 소개하며 “준우 오빠·형처럼 여러분도 멋지고 건강하게 자라길 바란다”고 응원하기도 했다.)

After the event, Kim handed out Hope Cookies and gift packages to the participants. Deputy Spokesperson Ahn said that Hope Cookies will also be delivered to children with glycogen storage disease who could not attend this event on Children's Day. (김 여사는 행사 후 참가자들에게 희망 쿠키와 선물 꾸러미를 전달했다. 안 부대변인은 이번 행사에 참여하지 못한 당원병 환아들에게도 어린이날에 희망 쿠키를 전달할 계획이라고 전했다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Visits Third New Town Site, Stressing "Housing Supply Concerns All Citizens… Must Be Built Quickly and Well" (金총리, 3기 신도시 현장 찾아 “주택 공급에 온 국민 관심… 빨리 잘 지어야”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Visits Third New Town Site, Stressing "Housing Supply Concerns All Citizens… Must Be Built Quickly and Well" (金총리, 3기 신도시 현장 찾아 “주택 공급에 온 국민 관심… 빨리 잘 지어야”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok visited the site of the government's third new town initiative on the 29th to inspect the project's progress. <<> Prime Minister Kim visited the Wangsuk 1 district in Namyangju, Gyeonggi Province, on the morning of that day and received a progress report from officials of the Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH). The Wangsuk 1 district, which plans to supply 80,000 housing units, began construction in 2022 and has completed land compensation, but the relocation rate stands at 77.2%, lower than planned. <<> Prime Minister Kim stated, "Housing supply is something all citizens are paying attention to, and the government is also prioritizing it," adding, "I hope (LH) can thoroughly check everything in advance to prevent bottlenecks (in the project's progress) and ensure it moves forward quickly." <<> An LH official reported that the Middle East war has caused construction material prices to rise and has also led to disruptions in securing materials. In response, the Prime Minister's Office said, "Prime Minister Kim instructed that the project should not be delayed by external variables, and that measures such as constantly managing material supply situations, diversifying suppliers, and utilizing alternative materials should be taken in a multifaceted and preemptive manner." <<> Prime Minister Kim then visited the Safety and Health Center, established for health checkups of on-site workers and response to accidents, and stated, "Strengthening safety in the public sector is extremely important. I hope LH operates it well. If this succeeds, it could become a model and spread to other sites across the country." <<> The Prime Minister's Office explained that this on-site inspection by Prime Minister Kim was "arranged to preemptively check for any delays and encourage the acceleration of the project, ensuring high-quality housing is supplied to citizens on time without disruption, especially amid concerns over construction material supply instability following the Middle East war." It added, "The government will continue to maintain an emergency economic response system and make all-out efforts to ensure supply of housing proceeds without hitches while minimizing industrial damage caused by the situation in the Middle East." (김민석 국무총리가 29일 정부가 추진하는 3기 신도시 현장을 찾아 사업 진척 상황을 점검했다.)

item.title: In Response to Opposition's Demand for Dismissal... Jeong Dong-young: "Are You U.S. Congressmen? Your Subservience to America on Security Issues Is Excessive" (野의 경질 요구에... 정동영 “美 의원이냐, 안보사안 숭미 지나쳐”)
item.description:
In Response to Opposition's Demand for Dismissal... Jeong Dong-young: "Are You U.S. Congressmen? Your Subservience to America on Security Issues Is Excessive" (野의 경질 요구에... 정동영 “美 의원이냐, 안보사안 숭미 지나쳐”)

Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young stated on the 29th that after publicly citing the Goseong region as a third uranium enrichment facility for North Korea, the U.S. imposed restrictions on information sharing. In response to opposition lawmakers calling for his dismissal, he said, "Are you U.S. congressmen?" <<> At a meeting with reporters following the "3rd 2030 Youth Advisory Group Inauguration Ceremony and Minister-Youth Dialogue" held at the Dorasan Observatory in Paju, Gyeonggi Province, Minister Jeong addressed the opposition's motion for his impeachment, stating, "While claiming that security issues should be handled in a cross-party manner, your excessive subservience to America is over the top." He added, "Calling for the U.S. to lift its unreasonable and inappropriate restrictions on (North Korea-related) information sharing is in the national interest." <<> Minister Jeong noted that during his personnel hearing in July of last year and at the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee in March of this year, he mentioned the Goseong region as the location of a North Korean uranium enrichment facility. At the time, members of the People Power Party on the committee showed no reaction, but after the U.S. raised the issue, they "started flustering and making a fuss." He criticized the opposition, saying, "Are you U.S. congressmen? As South Korean lawmakers, you should be representatives of the people and advocate for the national interest." <<> Regarding the People Power Party's floor leader, Song Eon-seok, citing the push for public discussion on using North Korea's official name, 'Joseon,' as grounds for dismissal, Minister Jeong responded, "That's their logic, not the view of the majority of the public." He said, "According to a recent survey asking the people, about 60% of respondents support peaceful two-state coexistence. Who among the people would oppose peace?" <<> During the 2030 Youth Advisory Group inauguration ceremony, Minister Jeong responded to a question about weakening perceptions of unification, saying, "The concept of unification is violent; what is urgently needed now is the institutionalization of peace." He added, "The more we shout for unification, the further we drift from it. Maintaining peace regardless of changes in government is the path to unification." (정동영 통일부 장관은 29일 북한 구성을 제3의 우라늄 농축시설로 공개 언급한 이후 미국의 정보 제공 제한이 이뤄진데 대해 정 장관 경질을 주장하는 야당 의원들을 향해 “미국 국회의원이냐”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Moon-soo’s Role Expands, Taking on Honorary Campaign Chair Positions in Six Regions (역할 커지는 김문수, 6곳 명예 선대위장 맡아)
item.description:
Kim Moon-soo’s Role Expands, Taking on Honorary Campaign Chair Positions in Six Regions (역할 커지는 김문수, 6곳 명예 선대위장 맡아)

Ahead of the local elections, former Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Moon-soo of the People Power Party is receiving a surge of requests. As of the 29th, candidates from six out of 16 cities and provinces nationwide—Busan, Ulsan, Daegu, North Gyeongsang Province, Gangwon, and Sejong—have appointed the former minister as honorary chair of their election committees. Requests from candidates in by-elections for National Assembly seats are also pouring in. Amid calls within the party for Representative Jang Dong-hyuk to step down to the second line, Kim’s role in unifying conservative candidates is gaining prominence. <<> Regarding his acceptance of the election committee chair positions, the former minister said in a phone call with this newspaper, “The current People Power Party candidates are in a desperate situation,” adding, “I received direct requests from those candidates, and I accepted with the resolve to protect at least the lifeline of conservatism.” Kim stated, “I will do my utmost to race across the country wherever I can.” On the 29th, he also attended the campaign launch event for Gangwon Governor candidate Kim Jin-tae in Chuncheon, Gangwon Province. Meanwhile, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk was reportedly not invited. <<> In August of last year, shortly after the presidential election defeat, Kim ran for the leadership of the People Power Party but lost to Representative Jang, who had the support of mainstream party lawmakers. However, as concerns grow that “the election cannot be won under Jang’s leadership,” candidates are turning to Kim ahead of the local elections. In last year’s presidential election, Kim received more votes than President Lee Jae-myung in Busan, Ulsan, Daegu, and North Gyeongsang Province. A People Power Party lawmaker commented, “If conservative sentiment consolidates like it did during the presidential race, we might at least lay the groundwork for a comeback.” <<> Regarding Kim’s assumption of the honorary campaign chair role in the Busan region, some inside and outside the party interpret it as “a strategic move with an eye on unifying conservative candidates in the Busan North Gap National Assembly by-election.” Currently, in Busan North Gap, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik and former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon are running as conservative candidates. Unlike the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership, which expelled Han, Kim has emphasized unity, stating, “Former leader Han Dong-hoon is a treasure of our party.” <<> In response to the calls for his resignation within the party, Representative Jang maintains the stance that “stepping down as party leader just because the situation is unfavorable is not responsible politics.” A close associate of Representative Jang said, “There will be no resignation before the local elections, and the role of co-campaign committee chair should naturally be fulfilled by the party leader.” (지방선거를 앞두고 국민의힘 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관에게 러브콜이 이어지고 있다. 29일까지 전국 16개 시·도 가운데 부산·울산·대구·경북·강원·세종 등 6곳의 후보가 김 전 장관을 명예 선대위원장에 위촉했다. 국회의원 재·보궐선거 후보들의 요청도 쇄도하고 있다고 한다. 당내에서 장동혁 대표의 2선 퇴진 주장이 나오는 가운데, 보수 후보 단일화 등에서도 김 전 장관 역할론이 부상하고 있다.)

item.title: For the First Time in 55 Years of RIMPAC Training… South Korea Takes Command of Multinational Naval Forces (림팩 훈련 55년만에… 한국이 다국적 해군 지휘권 잡는다)
item.description:
For the First Time in 55 Years of RIMPAC Training… South Korea Takes Command of Multinational Naval Forces (림팩 훈련 55년만에… 한국이 다국적 해군 지휘권 잡는다)

A South Korean Navy admiral will serve as the commander of the Combined Naval Component Command for the first time during the world's largest multinational maritime exercise, 'RIMPAC' (Rim of the Pacific), set to take place off the coast of Hawaii, USA, starting at the end of June. The Combined Naval Component Commander is responsible for commanding combined naval forces, including expeditionary strike groups and carrier strike groups. (한국 해군 제독이 오는 6월 말부터 미국 하와이 일대에서 열리는 세계 최대 규모의 다국적 해상 훈련 ‘림팩(RIMPAC·환태평양) 연합훈련’에서 처음으로 연합해군 구성군사령부 사령관 임무를 수행하게 됐다. 연합해군 구성군 사령관은 원정강습단·항모강습단 등으로 구성된 연합해군 전력을 지휘하는 역할을 맡는다.)

The U.S. 3rd Fleet announced on the 29th, "This year's RIMPAC exercise will see the South Korean Navy command naval forces and Canada command air forces under the direction of the Commander of the U.S. 3rd Fleet, who serves as the Combined Task Force Commander." South Korea served as the Deputy Commander of the Combined Naval Component Command during the previous RIMPAC exercise in 2024. This time, it has been elevated to the role of commander. Accordingly, a South Korean Navy rear admiral participating in RIMPAC is expected to assume the duties of the component commander. (미3함대는 29일 “올해 림팩 훈련은 연합기동부대 사령관을 맡는 미3함대 사령관 주관 하에 한국 해군이 해상 전력을 지휘하고, 캐나다가 공중 전력 지휘를 맡는다”고 밝혔다. 한국은 직전 훈련인 2024년 림팩에서 연합해군 구성군사령부 부사령관 임무를 수행했는데. 이번 훈련에서 사령관으로 격상된 것이다. 이에 따라 림팩에 참여하는 우리 해군 소장급 제독이 구성군 사령관 임무를 수행할 것으로 알려졌다.)

This marks the first time in 55 years since the start of RIMPAC in 1971 that the United States, which leads the exercise, has entrusted South Korea with this role. Analysts suggest that the U.S., seeking to share security burdens in the Indo-Pacific region with allies, intends to activate "South Korea-U.S.-Japan trilateral cooperation" by assigning naval command duties to South Korea, following Japan, which has consistently held the deputy commander position. (림팩을 주도하는 미국이 한국에 이 역할을 맡긴 것은 1971년 림팩 시작 후 55년 만에 처음이다. 인도·태평양 지역의 안보 부담을 동맹과 분담하고 싶어 하는 미국이 그간 고정적으로 부사령관직을 맡아 온 일본에 이어, 한국에도 해군 지휘 업무를 맡겨 ‘한·미·일 삼각 협력’을 활성화하려는 의도가 있다고 보고 있다.)

U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson recently stated in a media interview, "South Korea's assumption of a command role in RIMPAC and its participation in regional combined exercises show that it's not just a symbolic involvement but a realization of South Korea-U.S.-Japan security cooperation. Such exercises are crucial because they allow us to practice and improve mutual cooperation before a conflict arises." (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군 사령관은 최근 언론 인터뷰에서 “림팩 훈련에서 한국이 지휘 역할을 맡는 등 역내 연합훈련에 참여하는 것은 단순히 형식적 참여가 아니라 한·미·일 안보 협력이 구현되는 것을 보여준다”며 “분쟁이 발생하기 이전에 상호 협력을 미리 연습하고 개선할 수 있어 이런 훈련은 핵심적”이라고 했다.)

RIMPAC, now held biennially, marks its 30th edition this year with the participation of over 30 countries, including the United States, Canada, and Japan. Approximately 25,000 multinational personnel, including more than 40 surface vessels, five submarines, and 140 aircraft such as maritime patrol planes, will train together from June 24 to July 31. The South Korean Navy is expected to deploy its newest Aegis destroyer, the ROKS Jeongjo the Great, a P-8 maritime patrol aircraft, and the 3,000-ton submarine ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho for the first time in this RIMPAC exercise. (림팩은 현재 격년으로 실시되며 30회째를 맞는 올해는 미국·캐나다·일본 등 30여 국이 참여한다. 수상함 40여 척, 잠수함 5척 및 해상 초계기 등 공중전력 140기 등 2만5000여 명의 다국적 전력이 6월 24일부터 7월 31일까지 함께 훈련할 예정이다. 우리 해군은 최신예 이지스구축함인 정조대왕함, P-8 해상초계기, 3000t급 잠수함 도산안창호함을 이번 림팩 훈련에 처음으로 파견할 것으로 알려졌다.)

South Korea has participated in RIMPAC since 1990, and this will be its 19th involvement. It has built up its operational command capabilities, including commanding multinational combined amphibious assault forces under the component command in 2022. Dr. Yoo Ji-hoon, a research fellow at the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses and a former Navy lieutenant commander, said, "Beyond mere participation in RIMPAC, taking on actual command responsibilities signifies that the South Korean Navy becomes a more responsible contributing nation in Indo-Pacific maritime security cooperation." (한국 해군은 림팩에 1990년부터 참여했고, 이번이 19번째 참가다. 2022년 구성군사령부 예하의 다국적 연합 강습 상륙 부대를 총지휘하는 등 경력을 쌓아오면서 작전 지휘 능력을 인정받았다. 유지훈 한국국방연구원 연구위원(전 해군 중령)은 “림팩에 단순 참가하는 것을 넘어 실제 지휘 책임을 맡으면서, 한국 해군이 인도·태평양 해양 안보 협력에서 더 책임 있는 기여 국가가 된다는 의미가 있다”고 말했다.)

Japan has traditionally held the deputy commander role, assisting the Combined Task Force Commander, who is the U.S. 3rd Fleet Commander, in RIMPAC exercises as if it were an ex-officio position. A military source noted, "Japan's deputy commander role is more about supporting the commander within the overall command structure and coordinating overall operations, whereas the component commander role that South Korea is taking on this time is functional, directly responsible for commanding in the operational domain." (일본은 과거 림팩부터 미3함대사령관이 맡는 연합기동함대사령관을 보좌하는 부사령관을 당연직처럼 맡고 있다. 군 소식통은 “일본의 부사령관 역할은 전체 지휘부 안에서 지휘관을 보좌하고 작전 전반을 조정하는 성격이 강하고, 이번에 한국이 맡는 구성군사령관은 작전 분야를 직접 책임지고 지휘하는 기능적 역할”이라고 했다.)

Analysts suggest that the United States' emphasis on trilateral security cooperation among South Korea, the U.S., and Japan to counter threats from North Korea, China, and Russia, and its assignment of a command role to the South Korean Navy, reflects expectations that South Korea's role must evolve in line with changing regional security environments. As North Korea and Russia have recently grown militarily closer and China's naval power has strengthened, security experts point out that it is necessary to consider not only existing scenarios assuming "contingencies on the Korean Peninsula," such as a North Korean invasion or ground war, but also the possibility of third-party intervention via sea routes. (미국이 북·중·러의 위협에 대응하기 위한 한·미·일 3국 간 안보 협력을 강조하며 한국 해군에 사령관 임무도 부여한 데는 역내 안보 환경 변화에 맞춰 한국의 역할도 달라져야 한다는 기대가 있는 것으로 분석된다. 최근 북·러가 군사적으로 밀착하고 중국의 해군력이 증강되자, 안보 전문가들 사이에서는 북한의 남침과 지상전처럼 기존에 ‘한반도 유사 상황’으로 가정해 온 시나리오뿐만 아니라 해상 등을 통한 제3국 개입 가능성도 염두에 둬야 한다는 지적이 나오고 있다.)

However, in an interview with the Japan Times on the 29th, Commander Brunson stated, "We are not asking South Korea to deploy troops to Taiwan or the South China Sea. We are asking South Korea to maintain a strong defense posture domestically so that we (U.S. Forces Korea) can do more across the Indo-Pacific theater." Commander Brunson also said, "The size of U.S. Forces Korea at 28,500 personnel is not a ceiling but a baseline. What truly matters is not numbers but capabilities." This appears to indicate that rather than expecting South Korean troop deployments in a crisis across the Taiwan Strait, the aim is for South Korea to strengthen its defense capabilities on the peninsula to enable U.S. Forces Korea to exercise "strategic flexibility" by moving to other regions for operations in the event of regional contingencies. (다만 브런슨 사령관은 29일 ‘재팬타임스’ 인터뷰에서 “한국에 대만이나 남중국해로 파병해 달라고 요청하는 것이 아니다”라며 “우리(주한미군)가 인도태평양 전역에서 더 많은 일을 할 수 있도록 한국이 국내에서 강력한 방위 태세를 유지해 달라는 것”이라고 했다. 브런슨 사령관은 또 “주한미군 2만8500명 규모는 상한선이 아니라 기준선(baseline)”이라며 “진짜 중요한 것은 숫자가 아닌 역량”이라고도 했다. 양안 위기 시 한국군 파병 등을 기대하는 것이 아니라, 역내 유사 상황에서 주한미군이 다른 지역으로 이동해 작전을 수행하는 ‘전략적 유연성’을 발휘할 수 있도록 한국군이 한반도 방어 역량을 강화해야 한다는 취지로 보인다.)

item.title: Victor Cha: "South Korea Should Abandon the Kill Chain Preemptive Strike System Against North Korean Nukes" (빅터 차 “한국, 북핵 선제타격하는 킬체인 접어야”)
item.description:
Victor Cha: "South Korea Should Abandon the Kill Chain Preemptive Strike System Against North Korean Nukes" (빅터 차 “한국, 북핵 선제타격하는 킬체인 접어야”)

Victor Cha, a leading Korea expert and former hardliner on North Korea at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) in Washington, D.C., stated on the 28th that to reduce the risk of conflict on the Korean Peninsula, South Korea's military should cease its preemptive strike system, known as the "Kill Chain," in times of crisis. The Kill Chain, which detects signs of a North Korean nuclear or missile attack and launches preemptive strikes, is part of South Korea’s three-axis system, alongside the Korea Air and Missile Defense (KAMD) and the Korea Massive Punishment and Retaliation (KMPR) strategy. <<> Cha, who served as a director for the National Security Council (NSC) under the George W. Bush administration and was involved in U.S.-North Korea negotiations, said during a meeting with Washington correspondents, "The Kill Chain is a preemptive strategy, and it triggers North Korea to launch nuclear weapons. One of my recommendations is that South Korea should no longer pursue the Kill Chain." He also suggested that the U.S. and its allies should focus on "denial-based deterrence," which includes building a high-density missile defense system and regularly deploying U.S. fighter jets and submarines capable of carrying nuclear weapons to the Korean Peninsula. These remarks came as he explained the need for practical arms control negotiations with North Korea. <<> Cha argued that "North Korea’s denuclearization has become a goal that is difficult to achieve in the short term" and that the North Korea strategy should be adjusted toward starting U.S.-North Korea talks on arms control and nuclear non-proliferation. Regarding the perception that this could effectively mean "accepting North Korea's nuclear weapons," he said, "Denuclearization is always important and remains a goal we should continue to pursue. However, negotiations should not be limited solely to denuclearization. I don’t think the answer is to simply wait indefinitely for North Korea to denuclearize." <<> Professor Park Won-gon of Ewha Womans University said, "I find it hard to agree with the tone that seems to effectively give up on North Korea's denuclearization. However, I do sympathize with the point that the 'Kill Chain,' which entails preemptive strikes after detecting missile launch signs, is not easy to operate in practice and may carry risks of side effects." Recently, North Korea has tested solid-fuel ballistic missiles, which are difficult to detect in advance, and hypersonic missiles, which are hard to intercept due to their high speed and erratic maneuvers, continuously raising concerns about neutralizing the Kill Chain. <<> In contrast, Yang Wook, a research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies, said, "The Kill Chain is a 'defensive' concept that blocks an enemy attack at the final stage, just hours before it occurs. If the Kill Chain is abandoned, I question how North Korean missiles can be effectively defended." Lee Yong-joon, former South Korean ambassador for North Korean nuclear affairs and now chairman of the Sejong Institute, remarked, "While the term 'Kill Chain' may be somewhat provocative, regardless of what it is called, such defensive measures must be practically in place." (워싱턴 DC의 대표적 한반도 전문가이자 대북 강경론자로 꼽혀온 빅터 차 미 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS) 한국석좌가 28일 한반도 분쟁 위험을 낮추기 위해 한국군이 유사시 선제타격 체계인 ‘킬체인’을 중단해야 한다고 말했다. 북한 핵·미사일 공격 징후를 탐지해 선제타격하는 킬체인은 한국형미사일방어체계(KAMD), 대량응징보복 작전(KMPR)과 함께 한국군의 3축 체계를 구성한다.)

item.title: President Lee: "There Are Self-Harming Acts in Diplomatic and Security Issues" (李대통령 “외교·안보 문제에서 자해적 행위 있어”)
item.description:
President Lee: "There Are Self-Harming Acts in Diplomatic and Security Issues" (李대통령 “외교·안보 문제에서 자해적 행위 있어”)

President Lee Jae-myung hosted a luncheon on the 29th with five non-negotiating groups—the Fatherland Innovation Party, Reform Party, Progressive Party, Basic Income Party, and Social Democratic Party—along with independent lawmakers. While the President has previously met with leadership from non-negotiating parties, this marks the first time he has invited all lawmakers and independents for a meal. A total of 21 lawmakers attended the luncheon. Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, was absent due to local schedule commitments, and Yong Hye-in, leader of the Basic Income Party, was absent due to National Assembly standing committee review schedules. <<> In his opening remarks, President Lee stated, "Looking at examples from other countries, even when opinions differ on domestic issues and disputes arise, it's rare to find self-harming acts on external matters like diplomacy and security. Unfortunately, it seems we still have some of those elements remaining within us." <<> President Lee added, "As all citizens are aware, the external situation is very unfavorable. To overcome these difficulties, it would be good for us to take a public stance when viewing foreign relations domestically." Recently, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk has been voicing criticism of the Lee Jae-myung administration's foreign policy, including relations with the United States, during an 8-night, 10-day visit to the US. On his Facebook page, Jang wrote, "When it comes to 'self-harming acts on external issues,' I thought President Lee was speaking while looking in the mirror. Demanding a halt to anti-American, pro-China policies isn't a 'self-harming act' but 'protecting national interests.'" <<> At the meeting, floor leaders from each party offered suggestions to the President on various policy issues. Seo Wang-jin, floor leader of the Fatherland Innovation Party, said, "Please accelerate the energy transition centered on renewable energy." Yoon Jong-o, floor leader of the Progressive Party, stated, "The long-term holding special deduction, which causes property to become locked in, must be reformed." <<> Cheon Ha-ram, floor leader of the Reform Party, referenced the President's previous comment that "You can't get rid of the earthenware jar just because you're worried maggots might appear," criticizing schools that avoid picnics or school trips. Cheon said, "The problem isn't the fear of maggots. When the jar breaks while making soy sauce, it's because front-line teachers end up bearing all the responsibility." He proposed introducing a 'state liability system for teacher lawsuits' to protect teachers' rights. Han Chang-min, floor leader of the Social Democratic Party, requested a thorough review of the personal information leak incident at Coupang. <<> After the meeting went private, President Lee reportedly joked that "without lawmakers from the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party, gathering people who play a buffering role makes the atmosphere softer." (이재명 대통령이 29일 조국혁신당·개혁신당·진보당·기본소득당·사회민주당 등 비교섭 단체 5당과 무소속 국회의원과 오찬을 했다. 이 대통령이 비교섭 단체 정당 지도부와 만난 적은 있지만 전체 의원 및 무소속 의원을 모두 초청해 식사를 한 것은 이번이 처음이다. 이날 오찬에는 국회의원 21명이 참석했다. 이준석 개혁신당 대표는 지방 일정, 용혜인 기본소득당 대표는 국회 상임위 심사 일정으로 불참했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae "Swiftly Push for Special Counsel on Manipulated Indictments"... Some in Party "Worried About Backlash Ahead of Elections" (정청래 “조작기소 특검 신속 추진”… 당 일각 “선거 앞 역풍 우려”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae "Swiftly Push for Special Counsel on Manipulated Indictments"... Some in Party "Worried About Backlash Ahead of Elections" (정청래 “조작기소 특검 신속 추진”… 당 일각 “선거 앞 역풍 우려”)

As the National Assembly's special committee on the "suspected manipulated indictments by the Yoon Suk-yeol administration," led by the Democratic Party of Korea, has effectively concluded its activities, leader Chung Cheong-rae stated on the 29th, "We will now swiftly push for a special counsel." However, ahead of the June 3 local elections, some within the party are reportedly voicing opinions that "forcing a special counsel on top of the parliamentary investigation could negatively impact the elections." In particular, some election camps in the conservative-leaning Yeongnam region have reportedly conveyed concerns that "with the opposition defining the special counsel as a means to 'cancel the indictment' of the president's case, passing the special counsel bill before the elections could trigger a backlash." <<>> Park Seong-joon, the ruling party floor leader for the special committee, said at a press conference on the same day, "Since the parliamentary investigation confirmed the reality of the Yoon Suk-yeol administration's political prosecution manipulating indictments, we will thoroughly uncover the truth through a special counsel." He also mentioned that preparations are in place to introduce the special counsel bill at any time. A source from the special committee stated, "We need to introduce the special counsel bill in early May and process it in a plenary session before the local elections." Hardliners within the Democratic Party are reportedly pushing to quickly advance the special counsel while momentum exists, right after the conclusion of the parliamentary investigation. <<>> Nevertheless, some within the party are saying, "Since the special counsel could negatively impact the local elections in regions like Yeongnam, the timing of its processing needs careful consideration." In fact, a source from election camps in the Busan, Ulsan, and Gyeongnam areas remarked, "Although the party belatedly argued that the parliamentary investigation was not for canceling the indictment, the public sees the special counsel as a move to erase the president's trial. Since our support base wants it, the special counsel should proceed, but it should be postponed until after the elections." <<>> As a result, cautious views on the special counsel are reportedly emerging within the leadership as well. Senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun also said regarding the timing of introducing and processing the special counsel bill, "Additional discussions within the leadership are needed," adding, "There are the local elections to consider, and we also have to account for physical impacts, so a decision hasn't been made yet." A source from the leadership within the National Assembly also stated, "We need to discuss further whether to process it before the local elections." (더불어민주당이 주도하는 국회 ‘윤석열 정권 조작 기소 의혹 사건 국정조사’ 특별위원회가 사실상 활동을 마무리한 가운데, 정청래 대표는 29일 “이제 특검을 신속히 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다. 하지만 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 당 일각에선 “국정조사에 이어 특검까지 강행하면 선거에 악영향을 미친다”는 의견이 나오는 것으로 알려졌다. 특히 보수 세가 강한 영남권의 일부 선거 캠프에선 “야당이 특검을 ‘대통령 사건의 공소 취소용’으로 규정하고 있는 상황에서 선거 전에 특검법을 통과시키면 역풍이 불 것”이라는 의견을 전달했다고 한다.)

item.title: Special Counsel Appointed by President to Cancel President's Trial? Controversy Over Self-Pardon Inevitable (대통령이 임명한 특검이 대통령 재판 취소? 셀프 면죄부 논란 불가피)
item.description:
Special Counsel Appointed by President to Cancel President's Trial? Controversy Over Self-Pardon Inevitable (대통령이 임명한 특검이 대통령 재판 취소? 셀프 면죄부 논란 불가피)

As the Democratic Party of Korea pushes for a new special counsel following its "suspicion of fabricated indictments under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration parliamentary investigation," legal circles have raised concerns that the party's attempt to grant the special counsel authority to revoke indictments in cases such as President Lee Jae-myung's Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool scandals constitutes "unconstitutional legislation." (더불어민주당이 ‘윤석열 정권 조작 기소 의혹 국정 조사’에 이어 새 특검을 추진하면서 이재명 대통령의 대장동·쌍방울 사건 등에 대한 공소 취소 권한을 특검에 주는 특검법안을 추진하려는 것에 대해 법조계에서는 “위헌적 입법”이라는 지적이 제기됐다.)

A lawyer who previously served as a chief prosecutor stated, "Granting a special counsel the power to revoke indictments in cases it did not directly bring infringes on the judiciary's authority to hear cases and determine guilt or innocence. It amounts to the ruling party abusing its legislative power to destroy the constitutional principle of separation of powers." (검사장 출신 변호사는 “직접 기소하지 않은 사건에 대한 공소 취소 권한을 특검에 부여하는 것은 사건을 심리해 유·무죄 여부를 판단하는 사법부 권한을 침해하는 것”이라며 “거대 여당이 입법권을 남용해 헌법이 정한 삼권분립 원칙을 파괴하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Another lawyer who formerly worked as a prosecutor said, "Even if the special counsel believes that the prosecution's investigation was unlawful and that fabricated indictments occurred, that has not been confirmed by a court. Determining the guilt or innocence of criminal facts or whether evidence collected and submitted by the prosecution was fabricated are matters for the judiciary to decide." He argued that a special counsel law should not allow the special counsel to arbitrarily judge cases indicted by the prosecution and revoke indictments. (검사 출신 변호사는 “특검 시각에서 검찰 수사가 위법했고, 조작 기소가 이뤄졌다고 하더라도 그건 법원에 의해 확정된 사실이 아니다”며 “범죄 사실에 대한 유·무죄 판단이나 검찰이 수집·제출한 증거가 조작됐는지 여부는 모두 사법부가 판단해야 할 사항”이라고 했다. 특검이 검찰이 기소한 사건에 대해 자의적으로 판단해 공소 취소를 할 수 있게 특검법을 만들어서는 안 된다는 것이다.)

An indictment revocation is a procedure in which a prosecutor voluntarily withdraws an indictment. It can be carried out under the direction of the Minister of Justice to the Prosecutor General. Under the Criminal Procedure Act, an indictment can be revoked before the first trial verdict is rendered. How the Democratic Party's hardliners have structured this in the special counsel law remains unclear. Some speculate that the scope of indictment revocation could be extended to after the first trial verdict. (공소취소는 검사가 제기한 공소를 자진해서 철회하는 절차다. 법무장관이 검찰총장을 지휘해 진행할 수 있다. 형사소송법에 따르면, 1심 판결 선고 전까지 공소를 취소할 수 있다. 이 부분에 대해 민주당 강경파들이 어떻게 특검법을 정리했는지는 명확하게 알려지지 않고 있다. 일각에서는 공소 취소 범위를 1심 선고 이후까지 넓힐 것이라는 얘기도 나온다.)

In the cases of the North Korea remittance and Daejang-dong scandals, the trial for President Lee Jae-myung has been suspended after the first trial due to his election as president. Meanwhile, former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young received a final guilty verdict from the Supreme Court in the North Korea remittance case. Former National Security Office Director Suh Hoon was acquitted in the first trial for the 2020 killing of a South Korean fishery official, but the second trial is ongoing. (대북 송금, 대장동 사건의 경우, 이재명 대통령에 대한 재판은 대통령 당선으로 1심이 중단된 상태다. 반면, 이화영 전 경기부지사는 대북 송금 사건으로 대법원에서 유죄 확정 판결을 받았다. 서훈 전 국가안보실장은 서해 공무원 피격 사건에서 1심 무죄를 선고받았지만 2심이 진행 중이다.)

A lawyer with 20 years of experience commented, "If a special law is created to allow a special counsel—not a court ruling—to overturn cases that the Supreme Court or lower courts have deemed guilty through indictment revocation, that would be unconstitutional legislation." A lawyer who once served as a high-ranking judge added, "There is no precedent for the National Assembly's special committee on parliamentary investigations to probe cases that have already resulted in guilty verdicts, and for the Assembly to enable a special counsel to revoke indictments based on those findings." The Democratic Party included similar indictment revocation provisions in the Marine Corps special counsel law, but controversy was avoided when the special counsel, after a first-instance acquittal of former Marine Corps investigative chief Colonel Park Jeong-hoon, withdrew the appeal instead of exercising the indictment revocation power. (이에 대해 20년 경력의 한 변호사는 “대법원이나 하급심 법원에서 유죄로 판단한 사건을 법원 판결이 아니라 특검의 공소 취소로 뒤집을 수 있게 특별법(특검법)을 만든다면 위헌적 입법”이라고 했다. 고위 법관 출신 변호사는 “이미 유죄가 선고된 사건을 국회 국정조사 특별위원회가 조사 대상으로 삼고, 국회가 조사 결과를 바탕으로 특검이 공소 취소를 할 수 있게 하는 것은 전례가 없는 일”이라고 했다. 민주당은 해병 특검법에도 공소 취소 관련 조항을 넣었지만, 항명 혐의로 군사재판을 받던 박정훈 전 해병대 수사단장에게 1심 무죄가 선고된 후 특검이 공소 취소 권한을 쓰지 않고 항소 취하를 하며 논란을 피해 갔다.)

If the special counsel law passes the National Assembly plenary session, controversy is inevitable over President Lee potentially opening the door for "self-pardon" regarding his own cases. The law takes effect after approval by the Cabinet, which is presided over by the President. Legal circles argue, "If the President is involved in launching a special counsel that handles his own cases, and that special counsel can exercise the power to revoke indictments, it would be difficult to avoid criticism that it amounts to him resolving his own affairs." (특검법이 국회 본회의를 통과할 경우, 이 대통령이 본인 사건에 대한 ‘셀프 공소 취소’의 여지를 열어 놨다는 논란도 불가피하다. 특검법은 이 대통령이 주재하는 국무회의 재가를 거쳐 시행된다. 법조계에서는 “대통령이 자신의 사건을 다루는 특검 출범에 관여하고, 그 특검이 공소 취소 권한을 행사할 수 있다면 사실상 자기 사건을 스스로 정리하는 것과 다름없다는 비판을 피하기 어렵다”는 말이 나온다.)

The authority to appoint a special counsel lies with the President. The prospect of President Lee appointing the special counsel under the new law pushed by the Democratic Party is also expected to spark controversy. In particular, if the special counsel revokes indictments in cases related to President Lee, such as the North Korea remittance case, a conflict of interest arises. A current senior prosecutor stated, "It would mean the special counsel appointed by the President cancels the trial in which the President is the defendant. It seems difficult to persuade even the prosecution leadership, which operates according to the current administration's wishes, on the issue of indictment revocation, so they are using the special counsel to work on 'burying Lee Jae-myung.'" (특검 임명권은 대통령에게 있다. 민주당이 추진하는 새 특검법에 따라 이 대통령이 해당 특검을 임명하게 되는 것도 논란이 될 전망이다. 특히 특검이 ‘대북 송금 사건’ 등 이 대통령 관련 사건의 공소를 취소할 경우 이해 충돌 문제가 있다는 것이다. 현직 부장검사는 “대통령이 임명한 특검이 대통령이 피고인으로 있는 재판을 취소하는 셈”이라며 “현 정부 뜻대로 움직이는 검찰 지휘부를 상대로도 ‘공소 취소’ 문제는 설득이 어려워 보이니 특검이라는 조직으로 ‘이재명 죄 지우기’ 작업을 하려는 것”이라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to introduce the special counsel law as soon as possible. Lawmaker Park Seong-joon stated today, "About 150 political prosecutors targeted President Lee Jae-myung in a witch hunt. Since the state investigation has confirmed the fabricated indictments by the political prosecution under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, we will thoroughly uncover the truth through a special counsel." The special parliamentary committee is set to conclude its activities with a plenary session on the 30th. (민주당은 특검법을 최대한 빠른 시일 내 발의한다는 입장이다. 박성준 의원은 이날 “150여 명의 정치 검찰이 이재명 대통령을 목표로 두고 토끼몰이에 나섰다”며 “국정조사를 통해 윤석열 정권 정치 검찰의 조작 기소 실태가 확인된 만큼 특검으로 확실하게 진상을 규명하겠다”고 했다. 국조특위는 30일 전체회의를 끝으로 활동을 마무리할 예정이다.)

☞Indictment Revocation (☞공소 취소)

A procedure stipulated in Article 255 of the Criminal Procedure Act, referring to the prosecutor voluntarily withdrawing an indictment. The indictment can be revoked before the first trial verdict is rendered, and it can be carried out under the direction of the Minister of Justice to the Prosecutor General. Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho stated in June of last year, "Indictment revocation is the right approach for the President's case," but later in March said, "I have no intention or thought of directing such a revocation." (형사소송법 제255조에 규정된 절차로, 검사가 제기한 공소를 스스로 철회하는 것을 의미한다. 1심 판결 선고 전까지 공소를 취소할 수 있고, 법무장관이 검찰총장을 지휘해 진행할 수 있다. 정성호 법무장관은 지난해 6월 “대통령 사건은 공소 취소가 맞다”고 했다가 지난 3월 “(공소 취소를) 지휘할 의도나 생각이 전혀 없다”고 한 바 있다.)

item.title: Big Shots and Ex-Presidential Aides Flood In… The Arena Expands for the June 3 By-Elections (거물급·靑참모 대거 참전… 판 커진 6·3 재보선)
item.description:
Big Shots and Ex-Presidential Aides Flood In… The Arena Expands for the June 3 By-Elections (거물급·靑참모 대거 참전… 판 커진 6·3 재보선)

With nine incumbent lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties resigning on the 29th to run in the June 3 local elections, the number of constituencies for National Assembly by-elections has been set at 14. This marks the second-largest scale since the regular by-elections system was established in 2000. In this election, figures such as Cho Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party (Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi), Han Dong-hoon, former leader of the People Power Party (Buk-gu, Busan), Song Young-gil, former leader of the Democratic Party (Yeonsu-gu-gap, Incheon), and Lee Kwang-jae, former Gangwon Province governor from the Democratic Party (Hanam-gap, Gyeonggi), are running, drawing attention to whether these "big shots" from both sides will enter the National Assembly. (6·3 지방선거에 출마하는 여야 현역 국회의원 9명이 29일 의원직을 사퇴함에 따라 국회의원 재보궐선거 지역구가 14곳으로 확정됐다. 재보선이 정례화된 2000년 이후 역대 두 번째로 큰 규모다. 이번 선거에는 조국 조국혁신당 대표(경기 평택을), 한동훈 국민의힘 전 대표(부산 북갑), 송영길 전 더불어민주당 대표(인천 연수갑), 이광재 민주당 전 강원지사(경기 하남갑) 등이 출마하면서 여야 ‘빅샷’의 국회 입성 여부도 관심사다.)

On this day, from the Democratic Party, eight lawmakers—Choo Mi-ae (Hanam-gap, Gyeonggi), Park Chan-dae (Yeonsu-gu-gap, Incheon), Wi Seong-gon (Seogwipo, Jeju), Jeon Jae-soo (Buk-gu, Busan), Min Hyung-bae (Gwangsan-eul, Gwangju), Park Soo-hyun (Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang, South Chungcheong), Lee Won-taek (Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-eul, North Jeolla), and Kim Sang-wook (Nam-gu-gap, Ulsan)—stepped down from their seats to run for mayor or governor. From the People Power Party, Rep. Choo Kyung-ho (Dalseong, Daegu), a candidate for Daegu mayor, resigned. Combined with the five by-elections already confirmed earlier, a total of 14 constituencies will hold by-elections. (이날 민주당에선 추미애(경기 하남갑), 박찬대(인천 연수갑), 위성곤(제주 서귀포), 전재수(부산 북갑), 민형배(광주 광산을), 박수현(충남 공주·부여·청양), 이원택(전북 군산·김제·부안을), 김상욱(울산 남갑) 의원 등 8명이 시도지사 출마를 위해 의원직에서 물러났다. 국민의힘에선 대구시장 후보인 추경호(대구 달성) 의원이 사퇴했다. 앞서 재보선이 확정된 5곳까지 합쳐 총 14곳에서 재보선이 치러지게 됐다.)

The ruling party aims for a landslide victory in both the local elections—held a year after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration—and the by-elections. Since 13 out of the 14 by-election constituencies were previously held by the Democratic Party, the goal is to retain them all. The Democratic Party has strategically nominated former presidential office aides in four of the eight constituencies where candidates have been confirmed so far: Kim Nam-guk, former Presidential Secretary for Public Communication, in Ansan-gap, Gyeonggi; Kim Nam-joon, former spokesperson, in Gyeyang-eul, Incheon; Jeon Eun-soo, former spokesperson, in Asan-eul, South Chungcheong; and Ha Jung-woo, former Senior Secretary for AI Future Strategy, in Buk-gu, Busan. However, some within the ruling party have commented that "the flood of key presidential office aides entering the race could also become a burden on the president." The People Power Party plans to nominate candidates most likely to win to counter the Democratic Party's legislative overreach. <<>> (여당은 이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 치르는 지방선거와 함께 재보선도 압승을 목표로 하고 있다. 재보선 14곳 중 13곳이 직전까지 민주당 지역구였기 때문에 전부 사수하겠다는 것이다. 민주당은 현재까지 후보를 확정한 8곳 중 4곳에 청와대 출신 후보를 전략공천했다. 경기 안산갑 김남국 전 국민소통비서관, 인천 계양을 김남준 전 대변인, 충남 아산을 전은수 전 대변인, 부산 북갑 하정우 전 AI미래기획수석 등이다. 다만 여권에서도 “청와대 핵심 참모들이 대거 나가면서 대통령에게도 부담이 될 것”이란 말도 나온다. 국민의힘은 민주당의 입법 폭주를 막기 위해 최대한 승리할 후보를 공천할 방침이다.)

item.title: ‘Daytime for Park, Nighttime for Han’… The Dual Life of the People Power Party, Supporting Park Min-sik by Day and Han Dong-hoon by Night (‘주박야한’⋯ 낮엔 박민식 돕고 밤엔 한동훈 지지하는 국힘의 이중생활)
item.description:
‘Daytime for Park, Nighttime for Han’… The Dual Life of the People Power Party, Supporting Park Min-sik by Day and Han Dong-hoon by Night (‘주박야한’⋯ 낮엔 박민식 돕고 밤엔 한동훈 지지하는 국힘의 이중생활)

The by-elections for National Assembly seats, held alongside the June 3 local elections, are being contested in a total of 14 districts, scale of a mini general election. As their impact on central politics grows as much as the local elections, the clashes between the ruling and opposition parties are also intensifying. With races taking place nationwide, including the Seoul metropolitan area, Chungcheong, Honam, Yeongnam, and Jeju, each party is engaging in an all-out effort. Of the 14 districts, the Democratic Party is generally assessed to have the upper hand in the Seoul metropolitan area, Chungcheong, Honam, and Jeju. The People Power Party still has numerous districts where it hasn’t even begun candidate nominations. <<> The most closely watched races are in Pyeongtaek-B (Gyeonggi) and Busan’s Buk-gu-Gap. This is because heavyweight figures have all jumped in, and the outcomes could influence future political dynamics and the next presidential election landscape. <<> In Pyeongtaek-B, a fierce five-way race is unfolding, with candidates from the Democratic Party, the People Power Party, the Fatherland Innovation Party, the Progressive Party, and an independent. The Fatherland Innovation Party, led by its leader Cho Kuk, is pushing back against Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party’s nominee, arguing that Cho previously acted as a “sniper” targeting Cho Kuk, and protesting, “We thought you were on the same side, but you’re fielding a spoiler candidate.” <<> Initially, there were expectations that the Democratic Party might not field a candidate in this district, considering an electoral alliance with the Fatherland Innovation Party and the Progressive Party. However, the mood shifted after Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae set a policy of contesting all districts. Some are speculating, “Maybe Representative Jeong doesn’t want his potential rival Representative Cho to enter the National Assembly,” and “He’s trying to nip the competition’s bud, even if it means handing Pyeongtaek-B to the People Power Party.” Earlier this year, Jeong and Cho were allies pushing for a merger of the Democratic and Fatherland Innovation parties, but in the June 3 elections, they face off as competitors in what looks like a ‘Jo-Jeong Showdown.’ <<> The Progressive Party, whose co-chairperson Kim Jae-yeon is running, is criticizing Cho daily while pressuring the Democratic Party, saying, “If you don’t yield in Pyeongtaek-B, there will be no electoral alliance in the Gyeongnam region.” If the three parties fail to unify, the pan-opposition vote will split. This could allow Yu Ui-dong, the three-term People Power Party lawmaker from Pyeongtaek, to benefit as a third-party spoiler. Former opposition leader Hwang Kyo-ahn’s candidacy in this district also adds a variable. Conservative unification could also be on the table. <<> In Busan’s Buk-gu-Gap, former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon has already declared his candidacy, while former lawmaker Park Min-sik is preparing to run for the People Power Party. Within the party, there are strong calls for “pre-coordination” and “promoting candidate unification.” Analysis suggests that if both run and compete, they cannot defeat the Democratic Party. <<> However, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk strongly opposes unification. He signals that supporting Han or calling for unification will be considered a violation of party rules. There is a clear intent to prevent Han from entering the National Assembly, even if it means losing Buk-gu-Gap. <<> Internal sentiment within the People Power Party differs. Because it would be embarrassing for conservatives to split and lose Busan—practically their home turf—the term ‘jubak-yahan’ (晝朴夜韓) has even emerged. It means supporting former lawmaker Park Min-sik during the day and helping former leader Han Dong-hoon at night. It reflects a reality where they must live a dual life, changing allegiances between day and night. <<> For the People Power Party, the unexpectedly high approval rating of Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, the former presidential secretary for AI, is a burden. Even before officially declaring his candidacy, Ha has been leading within the margin of error with over 30% support. The controversy over his potential candidacy, lingering for over two weeks, has also boosted his public recognition. <<> However, Ha must overcome criticism that he “took too long testing the waters” and “You said you were creating a national AI strategy, but you’re running for office after all?” Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae pushed for him to run, but President Lee Jae-myung caused confusion by saying, “We can’t just let it slide if they’re moving in.” Doubts have also arisen about whether Ha deceived the public to attract attention by dragging out his decision to run. The consensus is that if the opposition fails to unify candidates and ends up in a three-way race, Ha is highly likely to win. <<> Unification games are playing out across these by-elections. Whether candidates unite will likely be the biggest variable. Another variable is the reunification of conservatives around leader Jang Dong-hyuk. His future moves and whether he participates in the campaign are hot topics. <<> In the People Power Party, there is a strong push to appoint former Minister Kim Moon-soo as the chair of its election committee in Daegu, Busan, Gyeongbuk, and Gangwon, effectively positioning him as an alternative to Jang. If a conservative reunification wave rises in some PK regions and travels along the Gyeongbu Line, through TK and Chungcheong, to the Seoul metropolitan area, it could shake the overall local election landscape. <<> In Pyeongtaek-B, former Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, former People Power Party lawmaker Yu Ui-dong, Fatherland Innovation Party leader Cho Kuk, Progressive Party co-chairperson Kim Jae-yeon, and independent former President Hwang Kyo-an have all thrown their hats in the ring. With three current or former party leaders and a former lawmaker, heavyweight figures have all assembled. <<> The key is unification. In January, leader Jeong Cheong-rae was in the same boat as Cho, pushing for a merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party. There was even talk of a role division after the merger: Jeong for party leadership, Cho for the presidency. But the merger fell through due to internal opposition from pro-Lee factions, and their relationship soured. Particularly, Jeong’s exercise of nomination rights in Pyeongtaek-B for this by-election has escalated tensions to a peak. It’s a case of “yesterday’s ally becoming today’s foe.” <<> Within the pan-opposition, some interpret that Jeong intentionally sent former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, who had acted as a ‘Cho Kuk sniper,’ to block his potential rival Cho from entering the National Assembly. Kim has left the door open for unification, aware of the Fatherland Innovation Party’s objections. But some predict unification will be difficult if the current trend continues. The Progressive Party has also set up a defensive line with Kim Jae-yeon as its candidate, attacking Cho daily while pressuring the Democratic Party, warning that “unification or electoral alliances we’ve been pushing in the PK region could collapse.” <<> If the three pan-opposition candidates fight in Pyeongtaek-B, the vote will split. This could also negatively affect electoral alliances in other regions. The beneficiary would be the People Power Party. If the three-way pan-opposition competition continues to the end, the likelihood of People Power Party candidate Yu Ui-dong winning increases significantly. However, if conservative unification with independent candidate Hwang Kyo-an doesn’t happen, the conservative vote could split, leaving Yu in a precarious position. <<> In Busan’s Buk-gu-Gap, former Democratic Party senior secretary Ha Jung-woo, former People Power Party lawmaker Park Min-sik, and independent former leader Han Dong-hoon are competing. Former lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo had tapped Ha as his successor, but Ha delayed his decision, declaring his candidacy only after two weeks. Ha attracted attention by leading in approval polls even before declaring, but how he performs politically from now on will be crucial. <<> Here too, the key is opposition unification. Even though former lawmaker Park Min-sik hasn’t yet received the People Power Party’s official nomination, controversy over unification with Han is already heated. Former Busan Mayor Seo Byung-soo and many Busan lawmakers argue unification is inevitable. Current Busan Mayor Park Hyung-joon also agreed on unification. But leader Jang Dong-hyuk remains stubborn. His intention is to block Han’s election, even if it means losing Buk-gu-Gap again. This is the background behind the term ‘jubak-yahan’ emerging within the People Power Party. Park also emphasizes “no unification,” but some predict that if a hierarchy between the two candidates emerges within 2-3 weeks, they will naturally move toward unification. <<> In Hanam-Gap (Gyeonggi), the Democratic Party has nominated former lawmaker Lee Kwang-jae, while within the People Power Party, the idea of nominating former lawmaker Yoo Seung-min is being raised. If Yoo can be persuaded to run, it would not only create a major matchup in Hanam-Gap but also significantly impact the Gyeonggi gubernatorial race. However, the likelihood is low, as Yoo is unenthusiastic about running, and leader Jang Dong-hyuk isn’t making much effort to persuade him. <<> In Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang (South Chungcheong), rumors are rife that former Chief of Staff Chung Jin-suk will run. It’s interpreted that Chung has a strong base there, and there is no alternative. However, the People Power Party worries that this could rekindle ‘Yoon Again’ or ‘insurrection frame’ narratives. Daegu Dalseong and Ulsan Nam-Gap are traditionally conservative strongholds, so the People Power Party is widely seen as having an advantage. <<> Of the 14 by-election districts, 13 were previously held by Democratic Party lawmakers. For the ruling party, this means winning all 13 is the baseline. Yet, Pyeongtaek-B and Busan’s Buk-gu-Gap are classified as ultra-competitive, and Ulsan Nam-Gap is assessed as an unfavorable contest. The situations in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, as well as Hanam-Gap, also depend on how candidate nominations play out between the ruling and opposition parties. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 실시되는 국회의원 재·보궐 선거가 총 14곳에 이르는 미니 총선급으로 치러집니다. 중앙 정치에 미치는 파급력이 지방선거 못지않게 커지면서 여야 간 공방도 가열되고 있습니다. 수도권과 충청·호남·영남·제주까지 전국에 걸쳐 진행되면서 각 정당이 총력전을 펼치고 있습니다. 14곳 중 수도권과 충청·호남·제주 등은 대체로 민주당이 우세하다는 평가입니다. 국힘은 아직 공천을 시작도 못한 곳이 수두룩합니다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Board of Audit and Inspection Launches Another Investigation into Yoon Administration’s Audit of ‘Moon’s Statistics Manipulation’ ([단독] 감사원, 尹정부의 ‘文 통계조작 감사’ 또다시 조사한다)
item.description:
On the 29th, the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) formed a large-scale task force (TF) to reinvestigate whether there were any errors in the audit conducted during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration regarding suspicions of statistics manipulation under the Moon Jae-in government. As the Democratic Party of Korea claims that the prosecution ‘fabricated the indictment’ in the statistics manipulation case, there are interpretations that this move aims to overturn the previous audit results in line with the ruling party’s intentions. <<> On the 28th, an internal BAI bulletin board announced the formation of a ‘TF for Follow-Up Actions on the Special Committee on State Affairs’. Lee Su-yeon, the Second Deputy Secretary General of the BAI, was appointed as the head, and approximately 30 auditors from the internal inspection division and departments responsible for re-deliberating audit reports were assigned. The TF is known to investigate the allegations of ‘coercive and fabricated audits’ raised by the Democratic Party against fellow auditors who conducted the statistics manipulation audit. <<> On the same day, the Democratic Party held a hearing at the National Assembly for the ‘Special Committee on State Affairs into Allegations of Fabricated Indictments,’ claiming that coercive investigations occurred during the BAI’s audit into the statistics manipulation suspicions. In response, BAI Secretary General Jung Sang-woo stated, “During this state audit, many grievances were expressed by those audited,” and added, “Following Chairman Kim Ho-cheol’s directive, we will activate a ‘TF for Follow-Up Actions’ with about 30 members.” <<> This is the second investigation into the audit of suspected statistics manipulation. Last year, after the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, the BAI organized an ‘Operational Reform TF’ to investigate the auditors who conducted the statistics manipulation audit. At that time, the TF stated, “To verify allegations of coercive audits, we thoroughly reviewed 23,677 pages of evidence documents, transcripts and audio files, and all Q&A video and audio recordings,” yet it concluded that no evidence of coercive audits was found. <<> In April last year, the BAI released a 903-page audit report revealing that the Moon administration’s Blue House, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, Statistics Korea (now National Data Service), and Korea Real Estate Board had long manipulated national statistics on housing prices, income, and employment. Some individuals identified as having manipulated the statistics have challenged this conclusion and requested a re-deliberation from the BAI. The TF is also tasked with determining whether to accept these requests. One BAI auditor commented, “If the TF concludes that ‘there were defects in the audit process,’ it could bring the audit report back for re-deliberation and potentially invalidate the existing conclusions.” (감사원이 29일 대규모 태스크포스(TF)를 구성해 윤석열 정부 시절 문재인 정부의 통계 조작 의혹을 감사했던 것에 잘못이 없었는지 다시 따지는 조사에 돌입했다. 더불어민주당이 통계 조작 사건을 검찰이 ‘조작 기소’했다고 주장하는 상황에서, 여당의 뜻에 맞춰 기존 감사 결과를 뒤집으려 한다는 해석이 나온다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam, Yoo Ui-dong, and Cho Kuk in a 20% Range Tight Race… Unification to Decide Fate of Pyeongtaek B District (김용남·유의동·조국 20%대 박빙… 평택乙 운명 가를 단일화)
item.description:
Kim Yong-nam, Yoo Ui-dong, and Cho Kuk in a 20% Range Tight Race… Unification to Decide Fate of Pyeongtaek B District (김용남·유의동·조국 20%대 박빙… 평택乙 운명 가를 단일화)

In the by-elections for National Assembly seats held alongside the June 3 local elections, candidate unification has emerged as a key variable determining victory or defeat. Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B and Busan North A were originally districts of the Democratic Party, but with candidates from the ruling party, opposition party, and even independents stepping forward, they are now competing in five-way and three-way races. Poll results have also shown that support rates for candidates are similar, making it difficult for anyone to guarantee victory. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 재·보궐선거에서 후보 단일화가 승패를 가를 변수로 떠올랐다. 경기 평택을과 부산 북갑은 원래 더불어민주당 지역구였지만 여야, 무소속 후보까지 나서면서 5자, 3자 구도로 대결 중이다. 후보들의 지지율이 엇비슷해 누구도 승리를 장담하기 어렵다는 여론조사 결과도 나왔다.)

◇Five-Way Race in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B <<> A by-election in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B, triggered by former Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Byung-jin receiving a ruling that nullified his election, has seen five candidates file so far. The Democratic Party nominated former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, who moved from the People Power Party to the Rebuilding Korea Party before joining the Democratic Party last year, while the People Power Party nominated former three-term lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong from Pyeongtaek. Also running are Cho Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, Kim Jae-yeon, co-chair of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of Liberty and Innovation. <<> In a poll conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 25th and 26th at the request of Pressian, candidate Cho Kuk received 23.4%, Kim Yong-nam 21.4%, and Yoo Ui-dong 21.2%, all within the margin of error (±3.7 percentage points). Candidates Hwang Kyo-ahn and Kim Jae-yeon also garnered significant support at 12% and 9.4%, respectively. <<> Within the pan-opposition bloc, the Progressive Party has already argued for an "electoral alliance of five democratic reform and progressive parties," demanding candidate unification. A Progressive Party official said, "With Kim Jae-yeon showing meaningful support, our push for an alliance has gained momentum." Candidates Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk have also left the door open to unification. In a radio interview on the 28th, Kim said, "If there seems to be a significant chance of victory, we could begin serious discussions." Cho stated on the 27th, "Solidarity among progressive and reform parties is essential." A Democratic Party official noted, "If the five-way race continues, Kim Yong-nam might win, but with Yoo Ui-dong having built a considerable local base and possibly uniting with former Prime Minister Hwang Kyo-ahn, the outcome is hard to guarantee." <<> Regarding the possibility of unification with Hwang Kyo-ahn, Yoo Ui-dong said, "In elections, you can't be certain," but added, "Personally, I think the likelihood is close to zero." In a phone call with this newspaper, Hwang said, "I will do everything possible for the right wing to win," adding, "I previously oversaw a conservative grand coalition when I led the Liberty Korea Party," leaving room for unification. <<> An opposition source commented, "If progressive unification materializes, the situation could change. An early variable is how much Yoo Ui-dong can consolidate conservative votes." <<> ◇Three-Way Race in Busan North A <<> In the by-election for Busan North A, triggered by Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo running for Busan mayor, former presidential secretary for AI future planning Ha Jeong-woo is expected to run as the Democratic Party candidate. On the conservative side, unification between the People Power Party candidate and former leader Han Dong-hoon, who declared an independent run, is a variable. In a poll conducted by News Tomato and Media Tomato on the 24th and 25th, former secretary Ha received 35.5%, former leader Han 28.5%, and former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik 26%. <<> In response to calls for unification, former Minister Park said to this newspaper, "Demanding unification is an insult to the residents. There is a 0% chance of unification." Former leader Han stated, "Before the greater cause of 'saving conservatism,' political engineering will become largely meaningless. Everyone who agrees with the 'southeast wind theory' of conservative reconstruction should gather on one path." <<> Within and outside the party, there is talk that "while the leadership under Jang Dong-hyuk is negative about unification, as the election approaches, pressure for unification will inevitably grow." Within the pro-Han faction of the People Power Party, there were calls for "no nomination" by not fielding a candidate, but a significant number of party lawmakers in Busan are advocating for "conservative unification." Former National Assembly Speaker Chung Ui-hwa, appointed honorary head of the People Power Party's Busan region election committee, said at a meeting with party leader Jang Dong-hyuk last year, "There's no reason not to join forces with former leader Han." (◇5파전 경기 평택을)

item.title: [Exclusive] Ruling Party's Special Committee Pushes for Special Counsel with Power to Withdraw Indictment ([단독] 與 국조특위, 특검에 공소취소권 추진)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea, having announced plans to pursue a special counsel following the National Assembly's "Special Investigation into the Yoon Seok-yeol Regime's Political Prosecution Manipulated Indictment Allegations," has been reportedly preparing legislation to empower the special counsel to withdraw indictments in ongoing trials as of the 29th. (더불어민주당이 국회 ‘윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 국정조사’에 이어 특검을 추진하겠다고 밝힌 가운데, 특검이 진행 중인 재판의 공소 취소를 할 수 있도록 법안을 마련 중인 것으로 29일 알려졌다.)

Based on the results of the future special counsel investigation, the aim is to allow the special counsel to withdraw indictments for seven cases, including President Lee Jae-myung's Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance cases. Legal experts point out that "if a special counsel ultimately appointed by the president overturns the decision to maintain an indictment in the president's own case, controversy is inevitable." (향후 특검 수사 결과를 근거로, 이재명 대통령의 대장동·쌍방울 대북송금 사건 등 7개 사건에 대해 특검이 공소 취소를 할 수 있게 만들겠다는 것이다. 법조계에선 “대통령이 최종 지명하는 특검이 대통령 사건의 공소 유지 여부를 뒤집게 된다면 논란이 생길 수밖에 없다”는 지적이 나온다.)

The special committee for the parliamentary investigation, led by the Democratic Party, is set to virtually conclude its activities on the 30th by adopting the final report of the investigation at a plenary session. The Democratic Party has immediately begun drafting a special counsel bill. (민주당이 주도해온 국정조사 특위는 30일 전체회의에서 국정조사 결과 보고서를 채택하는 등 사실상 활동을 마무리할 예정이다. 민주당은 곧바로 특검법 발의에 착수했다.)

According to the draft of the special counsel bill being prepared by Democratic Party lawmakers on the special committee, the scope of the special counsel's duties is known to include a provision stating that "it also covers whether to withdraw indictments in ongoing court cases." Withdrawing an indictment means the prosecution itself retracting a charge it has filed. This could also be carried out by the Minister of Justice directing the Prosecutor General. However, due to significant political burdens, such as backlash from the prosecution, the move appears aimed at having the special counsel handle the withdrawal of indictments instead. (국조특위 소속 민주당 의원들이 준비 중인 특검법 초안에 따르면, 특검의 직무 범위 조항에 ‘재판이 진행 중인 사건에 대한 공소 취소 여부도 포함한다’는 취지의 내용이 포함된 것으로 알려졌다. 공소 취소는 검사가 제기한 공소를 검찰 스스로 철회하는 것이다. 법무장관이 검찰총장을 지휘해 진행할 수도 있다. 하지만 그 경우 검찰 반발 등 상당한 정치적 부담이 따르기 때문에 특검을 통해 공소 취소를 하겠다는 것으로 보인다.)

The Democratic Party previously included a clause regarding the withdrawal of indictments in the Marine Corps special counsel law. This was intended to facilitate the withdrawal of charges against former Marine Corps investigation chief Park Jeong-hoon, who was facing a court-martial for insubordination. However, after Park was acquitted in the first trial, the special counsel did not exercise the power to withdraw the indictment but instead withdrew the appeal. Legal circles and the opposition have commented that "while former chief Park was acquitted in the first trial, President Lee's cases are in a state of suspension in the first trial," adding that "the Democratic Party granting the special counsel the power to withdraw indictments is an act of using legislative power to quash the president's cases." (민주당은 과거 해병 특검법에서도 공소 취소와 관련한 조항을 넣었다. 항명 혐의로 군사재판을 받던 박정훈 전 해병대 수사단장에 대한 공소 취소를 염두에 둔 것이었다. 하지만 박 전 단장이 1심에서 무죄를 받자, 특검은 공소 취소 권한을 쓰지 않고 항소 취하를 했다. 법조계와 야권에서는 “박 전 단장은 1심 무죄였지만 이 대통령의 사건은 1심 중단 상태”라며 “민주당이 특검에 공소 취소 권한을 준다는 건 입법 권력으로 대통령 사건을 무마하려는 행위”라고 했다.)

When the Democratic Party established the special committee for the parliamentary investigation in March, it claimed that "it is not for the purpose of withdrawing indictments," and even on the 29th, it stated, "There is no intention to mention the objective as withdrawal of indictments." However, as the parliamentary investigation wraps up, they have begun drafting legislation granting the special counsel the power to withdraw indictments. (민주당은 지난 3월 국정조사 특위를 꾸릴 당시 “공소 취소용이 아니다”라고 주장했고, 29일에도 “목적을 공소 취소라고 언급했는데 전혀 아니다”라고 했다. 하지만 국정조사 마무리와 함께 특검에게 공소 취소 권한을 주는 법안을 만들기 시작한 것이다.)

The People Power Party has argued that "if a special counsel is introduced solely for the purpose of withdrawing indictments, it would constitute a crime of abuse of authority committed by all Democratic Party lawmakers in collusion." (국민의힘은 “공소 취소를 위한 특검까지 도입한다면 민주당 의원 모두가 공모해 저지르는 직권남용 범죄”라고 했다.)
